cues: The dot product is a number, a b cos theta, zero for perpendicular vectors, and gives projections and work.
The cross product is a vector perpendicular to both, whose length is an area, and whose order matters.
It gives triangle areas, collinearity and moments.
And together they prove the compound angle formulas.
text: Quick recap. The dot product is a number, a b cos theta, zero for perpendicular vectors, and gives projections and work. The cross product is a vector perpendicular to both, whose length is an area, and whose order matters. It gives triangle areas, collinearity and moments. And together they prove the compound angle formulas.
